name: pi-branch-out
description: Fork Pi sessions into split terminal panes or new tabs, with a history picker and live message previews, rotating layouts, and optional model selection and message queuing. Supports cmux, tmux, iTerm2, Terminal.app, Ghostty, Warp, and Orca.
